title: Integration acceptance: the UI projects on one library release
goal: NERV, Hobo, Grover and FPVBuddy pin the same voidbrain/bricks release and use its tokens, checked from their main branches
acceptance: Version compatibility shows each project's pinned voidbrain/bricks release; an integration-acceptance row says how it is checked
Any project still on its own copy of a shared component is listed, not fixed here
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: read three package.json files and their style imports after adoption. Not a measurement.
